scope.summary: PL/SQL matrix offline test: OneRowMock's broad ALL_TAB_COLS/ALL_POLICIES catalog branches are narrowed to the bounded ROWNUM live-read-proof probes so bulk catalog-extraction queries fall through to catalog_extract_empty_rowset instead of being shadowed (columns now carry OWNER).
out_of_scope: the blind-catalog read-purity gate (bead joqnl / catalog_resolver.rs)

entry_points.name: OneRowMock catalog branch narrowing
entry_points.trace: crates/oraclemcp/src/dispatch/tests.rs: the mock now only answers `from all_policies`/`from all_tab_cols` probes that also contain `rownum` (lines 193/202); bulk extraction (no ROWNUM) falls through to catalog_extract_empty_rowset. The narrowing landed in 4a53e1c4 and is still present at source.sha 0aceec11 (the last commit touching this file, which added unrelated held-effect/custom_tool coverage); exercised by the PL/SQL feature-matrix offline dispatch tests via cargo test -p oraclemcp.

limitations: Scoped mock/regression proof only; full-suite green is asserted by CI. source.sha is the last commit that touched dispatch/tests.rs (0aceec11); the narrowing itself landed in ancestor 4a53e1c4 and is unchanged at source.sha.
